name: Kaleidoscope
desc: A live kaleidoscope where a wandering ink emitter is folded into N-fold dihedral symmetry every frame over a slowly spinning, zooming feedback buffer, blooming an endlessly evolving symmetric mandala-in-motion whose fold count steps by section.

fold.doc: N-fold mirror symmetry order (steps by section)

hue.doc: base hue anchor (jewel magenta by default)

style.doc: render philosophy: saturated additive gem glow / subtractive dark ink on paper / electric neon cores / leaded flat color cells / soft misty pastels

act.doc: dramaturgy: bloom (outward tunnel) / implode (inward suck) / churn (spin-heavy vortex)
